basis: Public Toss Securities product surface as of 2026-05-31; final API scope must follow official Open API docs when released.

conditional_asset_kinds.etn: Allow only when Toss official product/API universe explicitly marks the instrument tradable.
conditional_asset_kinds.commodity: Direct commodity trading is not assumed. Use Toss-supported commodity ETFs only.
conditional_asset_kinds.fx: Direct spot FX trading is not assumed. Use currency cash/환전 and FX exposure accounting only.
conditional_asset_kinds.future: Direct futures trading is not assumed until Toss official API explicitly supports it.

notes: Toss Securities public product page lists stocks, ETFs, bonds, and US stock options.
Toss Securities has public materials about broad US stock/ETF availability and overseas bond service.
Official API may support a narrower subset than the app platform; API docs override this profile.
Atlas Investment must not route unsupported futures, direct FX, or direct commodity orders through Toss.
